import numpy as np

def dft(x):
    x = np.asarray(x)
    n = np.arange(x.size)
    k = n.reshape((-1, 1))
    return np.exp(-2j*np.pi*k*n/x.size) @ x

def kalman_1d(zs, q, r):
    x, p = 0.0, 1.0
    out = []
    for z in zs:
        p += q
        k = p / (p + r)
        x = x + k * (z - x)
        p = (1 - k) * p
        out.append(x)
    return out
